title: 📈 AI-exposed workers wait a month longer for a job
text: 📈 AI-exposed workers wait a month longer for a job Exponential View Subscribe Sign in 📈 AI-exposed workers wait a month longer for a job Plus: Slow chips, Steam runs on AI & the ozone hole++ Azeem Azhar and Hannah Petrovic Nov 09, 2026 ∙ Paid 86 1 2 Share In the AI Investment Brief today: The funding quality is still a concern even as hyperscalers move into long‑dated, investment‑grade debt. Hi, Here’s the latest roundup of data signals across AI, energy & markets from Exponential View. Subscribe Anthropic’s place in the queue. Anthropic paid $3.4 billion to take over a supplier’s two-year-old order for 1.7GW of gas generators – the largest known power-equipment purchase by an AI lab. VC in 2026 is about two giants . Take a16z out, and US fundraising looks much like 2025. Without SpaceX, this year’s exits are close to last year’s. Memory hoarders. Apple’s memory inventory grew 2.5x year on year, helping build protection against memory cost increases. Re-application slowdown. Workers let go of jobs in AI-exposed roles in 2025 took about a month longer than peers in other roles to get a new job .
